description: Standardized end-to-end ML pipeline in one YAML — source + steps + outputs. 27 ops covering feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, interpretability, and model persistence. Any sklearn/XGBoost/LightGBM estimator via sklearn_class: escape hatch. Warehouse-connected via any Dagster resource. Partition-aware.

inputs.description: Source data — URL, file, warehouse SQL, or upstream asset (kind = url|file|warehouse_query|upstream_asset).

outputs.description: One or more first-class asset outputs (declared via outputs.assets: [step_ids]), plus optional csv / parquet / table sinks.

asset_name_prefix.label: Asset Name Prefix
asset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for emitted asset names. Each step listed in outputs.assets becomes '{prefix}_{step_id}'.

source.label: Source
source.description: Data source. kind = url | file | warehouse_query | upstream_asset. warehouse_query requires resource_key + sql; auto-detects the required_resource_keys.

steps.label: Steps
steps.description: Ordered pipeline steps. Each: {id, op, ...op-specific args}. Steps chain by id — a step with `source:` (or `input:`, `model:`) points at another step's output; omit `source:` and it defaults to the most recent DataFrame in state. 27 ops available across preprocessing / feature-engineering / selection / time-series / split / train / evaluate / interpret / persist.

outputs.label: Outputs
outputs.description: Output declaration. Shape: {assets: [<step_ids>], csv_sinks: [], parquet_sinks: [], table_sinks: []}. `assets:` step outputs become first-class Dagster assets; sinks are side effects. All sink paths are `{partition_key}`-aware; table_sinks accept a `partition_column:` for the analytics-friendly single-table pattern.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Group name for emitted assets. Default: 'ml'.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional tags for the emitted assets.
